---
title: "Native Wrapped Path Diagnostic"
format: gfm
---

# Purpose

This note documents the opt-in source declaration for native wrapped muscle
paths. It enables exact-source replay and route observation for a narrow set of
OpenSim components. It does not certify anatomy, physiological plausibility,
global path worklessness, or an independently supported physical endpoint.

# Closed Source Profile

The declaration binds the complete model SHA-256 and records each native
`WrapCylinder`, `WrapEllipsoid`, or `WrapSphere`, including its absolute path,
parent frame, transform, active flag, quadrant, shape dimensions, and serialized
component hash. Each `PathWrap` must resolve to one of those exact objects and
records its owner, target name and path, method, range, and serialized hash.
Each `ConditionalPathPoint` records its owning path, exact coordinate path,
active range, and serialized hash.

The native source is reloaded and compared against the declaration before the
constrained replay can proceed. A changed source, unresolved target, unsupported
shape or method, invalid range, or mismatched component identity is an
execution blocker. The legacy path still rejects wrapped components unless the
caller supplies this explicit declaration.

# Native Observation and Qualification

Route and conditional-point observations reuse the maintained native
reference-state observer. They report what the SDK evaluates for a declared
state and do not infer behavior outside observed states. A route transition or
missing global workless/guide-work budget proof remains unqualified; it must be
represented as a separate qualification finding and requires the diagnostic
opt-in. Nonfinite geometry or inconsistent native route evaluation blocks the
attempt.

This profile does not admit SimmSpline or other nonlinear MovingPathPoint
functions, generalized CustomJoint functions, contact components, or arbitrary
force components. Those require separate typed source closure and native
replay evidence. It also does not impose physiological thresholds.

# Validation

The focused test module is `tests/opensim/test_native_wrapped_path.py`. It
checks all three supported shapes with active native wrapping, exact-source
mutation rejection, PathWrap target closure, conditional path-point state on
both sides of its range, unchanged default rejection, and declared replay.

Run it with the repository's pinned OpenSim 4.6 environment. For solver tests,
set `CASADIPATH` to the environment's `site-packages/opensim` directory and
limit `OMP_NUM_THREADS`, `OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS`, and `MKL_NUM_THREADS` to `1`.
